description: Check a landlord's rent increase notice, given from 1 April 2025, for a private tenancy in Northern Ireland other than a controlled tenancy (do not use it for a controlled tenancy, which has different rules): whether it is in writing, whether the new rent starts at least three months after the notice is given, and whether it comes at least 12 months after the tenancy began and the last increase; and when the new rent can start. Northern Ireland only; it does not judge whether the new rent is fair.

history.description: Whether the rent has gone up before: none, increased (give lastIncrease), or unknown.

lastIncrease.description: If the rent went up before, the day that increase took effect, as YYYY-MM-DD.

received.description: The day the tenant was given the notice, as YYYY-MM-DD; from 1 April 2025.

starts.description: The day the notice says the new rent starts, as YYYY-MM-DD.

tenancyStart.description: The day the tenancy was granted, as YYYY-MM-DD.

written.description: Whether the notice is in writing; an email, text or other electronic message counts.

name: check_northern_ireland_rent_increase_notice
title: Northern Ireland rent increase check
